title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S06 E02 — The Rat Pack
When a drug dog alerts a vehicle full of clubbers heading to a techno bar, officers find the group has gotten creative with their illicit drugs; officers inspecting a couple's truck find bags full of rat carcasses to be used in a specialty soup.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S03 E09 — The Hitman
Agricultural inspectors intercept nearly 50 gallons of illicit moonshine; a former cartel hitman is extradited back to Mexico; a random vehicle inspection turns up a major seizure; a woman is caught attempting to smuggle prescription meds.

title: Bering Sea Gold
description:
S17 E08 — No Sleep Till Landfall
As the countdown to the storm of the century begins, the fleet races to mine; Reaper Nation hits deeper waters while Shawn, Emily, Vernon and Chris all fight large swells to get gold until the bitter end.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E06 — Rocked to the Core
When a rogue wave pummels the Wizard and sidelines its crew, Keith reconsiders the risks he's taking; racing to make an offload, Sig loses a deckhand to a crushed toe.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E07 — Wrong Side of the Law
When Monte discovers Keith set pots in an illegal zone, he and the Wizard crew must pay the price in blood and treasure; a storm reconnects Jake to the larger-than-life hero of the Cornelia Marie's past.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S22 E08 — Anything That Can Go Wrong
When Sig's crane blows a hydraulic line, Clark ascends the rig in 20-foot seas for a critical repair; the Cornelia Marie crew battles a fire as Jake's engine room fills with smoke.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E06 — Bones in the Backwoods
When a moonshine kingpin murdered a rogue bootlegger in 1948, fear kept witnesses silent.

title: Moonshiners: True Crime & Shine
description:
S02 E03 — Seaside Speakeasy Conspiracy
Mark, Digger and Tim investigate a Prohibition-era speakeasy in Connecticut that served bootleg liquor to the hottest celebrities of the day; when New York's mobsters come calling, glamour gives way to gunplay, federal agents close in.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E06 — The Bumper Sticker Brawl
Tizzy investigates an assault triggered by a bumper sticker; a judge dishes out justice for an attack on a fast food worker, and a couple of road rage incidents have Tizzy fired up.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery Pistol Packer
Tizzy tries to identify a man filmed pulling a gun on skateboarders; a road rager who reportedly used his coffee cup as a weapon is identified by his tattoos; a confrontation over a car charger leaves a woman seeking Tizzy's help.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E07 — Road Rage on the Underage
Tizzy investigates a driver who violently assaults a teenage boy riding a bike; a customer catches a brazen shoplifter, and a woman nearly runs over her boyfriend at a gas station.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E05 — The Nightmare Neighbor
Tizzy sparks an internet movement to end a woman's racially charged harassment of her neighbors; a parking lot guard is targeted by a driver; a disgruntled customer wrecks a GameStop.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E08 — Beverly Hills Banger
Tizzy investigates a frightening confrontation between a man and a pair of Beverly Hills reality show stars; a woman allegedly pepper sprays another driver for going too slowly, and a delivery person busts up a Taco Bell.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E04 — Digger Knows Best
Facing more demand for corn liquor than he can handle, Josh turns to Digger for help. Tim and Tickle discover their oddball neighbor is running an illegal moonshine operation of his own.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E05 — Hillbilly Scotch
Josh's head spins when Jerry reveals his wild plans for their joint moonshine operation. Mark and Digger enlist a Scotsman to help craft the first Hillbilly Scotch.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E06 — Up in Smoke
When their hillbilly scotch experiment flames out, Mark and Digger light a fire under their still hand, Kelly. Josh's lucrative 80-gallon moonshine order rides on Jerry's unproven vacuum still experiment. Mike devises a recipe to poach Jerry's buyer.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E07 — Shiner Patriot
For America's 250th anniversary, Tim and Tickle produce revolutionary-era moonshine; Digger questions Mark's attempt at his ancestor's sour corn whiskey; Josh and Jerry's plans fail.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E08 — Mash Bill of Rights
As Tim and Tickle add molasses to their 18th-century mash bill and heat their vintage copper still with wood fire, Howard takes the revolutionary spirit too far. Demand for Josh's shine outpaces supply as Jerry opens a new front in his war with Mike.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E08 — All Slot and Bothered
A high roller demands the return of his favorite slot machine as security goes undercover to catch hustlers targeting casino guests. Meanwhile, a poolside confrontation spirals out of control, stretching the Golden Nugget team thin.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S01 E08 — The Maine State of Cash
In the largest hoard he's ever tackled, Matt must find rare military plane parts, vintage records and a hidden jewelry cache to have a shot at making a profit; he brings in heavy equipment to clear the property and dig for big-ticket items.

title: Filthy Fortunes
description:
S02 E13 — From Rats to Riches
Matt's team goes full hazmat suit to tackle a rat-infested hoard that is rumored to have cash hidden in every room, if the rats haven't eaten it already; the team also hunts for vintage Playboys, a rare samurai sword and original G.I. Joe toys.

title: Bering Sea Gold
description:
S17 E09 — Apocalypse Nome
As the miners try to secure their operations, a catastrophic storm rips through Nome, devastating the community and leaving it forever changed.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E03 — Blackbeard's Ghost
Heather and Phil explore Ocracoke Island, where locals fear the ghost of Blackbeard is lingering; is the pirate's restless spirit protecting hidden treasure, or seeking vengeance upon the living?

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E06 — Terrors of Trinidad
Reports of shadowy figures and malevolent spirits from Caribbean folklore draw Phil and Heather to Trinidad; they explore a notorious plantation and an abandoned island once used as a leper colony, searching for the source of the chilling activity.

title: Expedition X
description:
S11 E07 — Nightmare Island
In Trinidad, Heather and Phil continue to confront terrifying claims of demonic possession and Obeah curses, tracing the sinister forces that locals say still grip the island.

title: Expedition X
description:
S10 E09 — The Bridgewater Triangle
Massachusetts' Bridgewater Triangle is America's leading hotspot for all things unexplained: UFOs, cryptids, and even supernatural encounters; Heather and Phil's investigation pushes them toward the center of the Triangle: the Hockomock Swamp.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E05 — Dark Waters
Josh Gates investigates three aquatic mysteries: the Kraken, Lake Lanier and Atlantis; from terrifying sailor lore, to a deadly lake's dark past and a lost city beneath the sea, he searches for evidence.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S01 E02 — Monsters Unmasked
New evidence suggests Jack the Ripper's identity, while DNA analysis indicates possible Yeti existence; Max Headroom interrupts live broadcast, surprising everyone.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S03 E05 — Behind the Myth
High on Everest's icy slopes, two climbers vanish into legend. In a quiet West Virginia town, a ghost demands justice from beyond the grave. And learn the real story of Mata Hari -- the exotic dancer condemned as a German spy.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S01 E01 — Invisible Enemies
Josh Gates steps into the past to examine unsolved mysteries; featuring the alleged alien abduction of Travis Walton, the bizarre death of American hero Charles Lindbergh's son, and the invisible attacks visited upon CIA operatives in Cuba.

title: Monsters Inside Me
description:
S09 E01 — What's Feeding on You?
Revealing an extraordinary medical first, a woman pulls live worms from her eye; a hunter discovers that a tick bite has turned eating everyday food into a dangerous gamble; a woman returns from Hawaii with parasites attacking her nervous system.

title: Monsters Inside Me
description:
S09 E02 — The Beach, the Bug and the Bite
A beach trip leaves worms burrowing under a teen's skin; a routine blood donation exposes a woman's hidden parasitic infection; a bout of searing pain leads an Alaskan fishing guide to suspect a worm has traveled from his stomach to his liver.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S02 E14 — Columbus: Legend or Liar?
The myths behind Christopher Columbus are uncovered.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E03 — Chasing the Fortune of Sir Francis Drake
Josh Gates searches land and sea for the lost fortune of legendary pirate Sir Francis Drake; joining treasure hunters and maritime archaeologists, Josh hunts for a lost cache of Spanish gold and the remains of Drake himself.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S03 E01 — Plummer's Gold
Josh Gates heads to Montana, the Gold Rush territory to search for the missing fortune of notorious Old West sheriff, Henry Plummer.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S03 E04 — The Lost Colony of Roanoke
America's first missing-persons case, the Lost Colony of Roanoke, is investigated with newly discovered clues.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E03 — Lost City of the White Jaguar
Trekking deep into Mexico's narco-controlled jungles, Josh hunts for the last Mayan stronghold to ward off the Spanish conquistadors; he joins an expedition braving snakes, spiders and jaguars to uncover the legendary Sac Balam.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Josh's Favorites: Treasure of the Pirate King
Risking life and limb, Josh finds treasure from the greatest score in pirate history.

title: Monsters Inside Me
description:
S09 E03 — Bears, Brains and an Eye Invader
A newlywed facing brain surgery gets a shocking diagnosis. A hunter risks losing a finger after cutting himself on a bear trap. A traveler battles an eye-destroying amoeba after a routine habit puts her vision at risk.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E10 — Mystery of the Alien Base
Abandoned hangers and bunkers populate a bizarre facility in the middle of nowhere, but among them are other structures whose purpose are oddly obscured; experts investigate a highly-classified military cover-up with extraterrestrial objectives.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E11 — Ghosts of the Cursed Castle
The ruins of a historic Scottish castle is now a bewitching wilderness of hidden dangers with deadly booby traps obscured afoot; experts and historians reveal a bygone Second World War military hospital with bizarre ties to an infamous Nazi occupant.

title: MythBusters
description:
S15 E02 — Moonshine Myths
Testing an exploding still; using "hooch" to fuel an unmodified car.

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E15 — Greased Lightning
The team dives into "Hell's Kitchen" to test two potential kitchen catastrophes and myths involving grease fires and water; the build team tries to blow up C4 in a microwave and use cheese in a cannon.

title: MythBusters
description:
S06 E02 — Exploding Steak
Jamie and Adam try to tenderize steak with explosives; they test to see if a motorist uses more fuel when driving under stress.

title: MythBusters
description:
S13 E01 — Titanic Survival
James Cameron joins Adam and Jamie to try to answer the questions, did Jack (from Cameron's "Titanic") needlessly die? Is it possible that Rose and Jack could have both fit on the wooden board and survived together?

title: MythBusters
description:
S07 E03 — Banana Slip, Double Dip
Adam and Jamie take on two classic comedy myths; Kari, Grant and Tory try to make homemade diamonds.

title: MythBusters
description:
S13 E07 — Food Fables
Celebrity chef Alton Brown helps the team discover if it can cook lasagna in a dishwasher or a meal beneath the hood of a car.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S05 E17 — Reindeer Farm
Host Mike Rowe takes a walk on the wild side to work on a reindeer farm, introducing us to these unique animals and the people who make their living looking after them.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S04 E05 — Cranberry Farmer
Join host Mike Rowe as he gets down and dirty making handmade bricks in South Carolina; he later masters the art of cranberry farming in Oregon.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S04 E28 — Gourd Maker
Mike cleans out a Connecticut lake, then travels to Pennsylvania to a gourd farm to make artwork out of the gourds for Halloween time.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S03 E07 — Wine Maker
Mike takes on the dirty job of making wine. After that he goes to a Kansas Cattle Ranch where he learns how dirty the cattle business can be.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S03 E06 — Salt Miner
Mike explores the world of salt mining; working in cramped conditions with powerful explosives, he develops a newfound respect for the people bringing salt to the dinner table.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S04 E09 — Dirty Jobs of the Big Apple
Join Mike Rowe as he takes on some of the dirtiest jobs in New York City; he scales a skyscraper to build a water tower on the roof before trying his hand at lift repair.

title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations
description:
S08 E18 — Brooklyn
The last episode; Tony travels through Brooklyn with Talib Kweli; actors from The Wire; dines with Eric Ripert at Brooklyn Fare.

title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations
description:
S08 E10 — Sydney
Tony visits Sydney and experiences enviable food and drink; he attends a rugby match, dines on traditional meat pies and swims with giant sea creatures.

title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations
description:
S08 E03 — Croatian Coast
Tony is treated to Mediterranean cuisine in Croatia.

title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations
description:
S08 E02 — Kansas City
Tony goes to Kansas City to look for the best barbecue and meets up with Dan and Patrick from The Black Keys.

title: Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations
description:
Holiday
Tony has a hallucinatory Christmas journey in which he meet Norah Jones, a vegan death metal chef, Samantha Brown and Christopher Walken.

S08 E15 — Rio
Drinking caipirinhas; pork sandwiches; stew of filet mignon cooked with garlic, onion, tomato, farofa and feijoada.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E07 — Hunting a Big Score
Hunter takes on the arctic tundra when a geologist's lead points to crazy gold on the edge of the Hoffman claim; Andy works to turn pay dirt from an ancient river channel into a big payoff.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E08 — The Mother Lode
The Hoffmans discover a huge vein of gold that could save their season if they can get it out of the ground in time; as the mine equipment fails, pressure mounts on their mechanic, Randy, to keep it all running.

title: Gold Rush
description:
Top Ten Fan-Favorite Moments
Join us for a countdown of Gold Rush fans' top 10 favorite moments across fifteen seasons of Gold Rush. Which one will be Number One?

title: Gold Rush
description:
When Parker Met Rick
Rick Ness takes a job working on 16-year-old Parker Schnabel's gold mine; the two miners form a strong bond, bringing in millions in gold, but a falling-out changes everything.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E04 — Disaster in Denver
Mountain Recovery faces a tight deadline to recover a semi in a Denver water reservoir; high winds roll over a hauler carrying groceries through Wyoming.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E05 — Ain't Worth Dying For
As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E07 — Spinning Out on I-80
A windstorm near Salt Lake City overturns a semi with a mystery load; a hauler with a heavy-duty load of data center cooling units spins out of control on I-80; Mountain Recovery's rookie operator fights a multi-front battle.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S03 E09 — Home Is Where the Gold Is
A family sells everything to purchase a 150-acre gold-rich property to mine and homestead; as their families grow, their gold production does not; shutdowns and broken equipment send Freddy and Juan's plans off track, forcing all-new ingenuity.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S03 E10 — Gold Habits Die Hard
A struggling Oregon miner brings in Freddy and Juan to double his gold, which will convince best friend Terry to invest in his Oregon mine; the duo proposes a radical fix, but they may have bitten off more than they can chew.
